name: network-section
purpose: The infrastructure band of a marketing page: a tall framed panel with the world network map drawn behind a small left-aligned title, a lead line and a row of claim chips, closed by a floor of either client outcomes (a quote with its highlights and the client's mark) or benefits (icon-led topics). It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'network-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `network-map`, `section-title`, `card-grid`, `quote` and `topic`. `kind` picks the floor only: `outcomes` renders four quotes, `benefits` three topics; the band above is the same.
useWhen: To state the network's reach with figures and back it with either client results or product benefits.
avoidWhen: For a logo wall with one quote → use `logo-wall-quote`.
related: network-map` — the animated map behind the copy.
quote` / `topic` — the two cell types the floor renders.
bestPractices: Four short `claims`; they are chips, not sentences.
Four `outcomes` or three `benefits`, so the floor closes the grid.
Use `logoTreatment: 'monochrome'` for a dark mark that must invert in the dark theme; leave `as-is` for a colour mark.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Which floor closes the band: `outcomes` renders the client quotes, `benefits` the icon-led topics.

props.name: title
props.doc: Headline of the band, rendered by the small section title as its `h2`; the band renders nothing when empty.

props.name: claims
props.doc: Short figures rendered as chips under the lead, in order.

props.name: outcomes
props.doc: Client results for the `outcomes` floor, in order; each is `{ logo, logoAlt, logoTreatment?, text, highlights? }` where `logo` is the mark URL, `logoTreatment` is `'monochrome'` or `'as-is'`, and `highlights` are the phrases of `text` set in the accent.

props.name: benefits
props.doc: Topics for the `benefits` floor, in order; each is `{ icon, title, description }`.
